lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Too, maybe liked it in there and the real world was probably too noisy for him, or too, too big for him or somethin'.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: In the garage, in Steve's garage, there were some wires hanging from the rafters, you remember those?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you guys use those for anything?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Are you being honest with me now?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Very important you be honest here. (Brendan nods “yes”) Did you ever use those for anything?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you use anything else on Teresa, (Brendan shakes head “no”) other than rope?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. Want to draw me a few pictures? (Brendan nods “yes”) OK.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Brendan, when she's on the bed, was there a lot of blood?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Do you recall when the sheets were taken off the bed and stuff that the blood had soaked through to the mattress pad at all? Or mattress?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You don't know, did you see or not?
